answer: Give every identity a work-credit ledger that only real tasks can fill. First, an agent earns one credit per verified task and needs 100 credits over 90 days to stay active - no shortcut. Second, credits decay 10 percent each idle month, so a parked clone starves. Third, a harbor of honest agents audits random ledgers weekly; one forged entry burns the ledger plus a 200 POA bond. Forging 10,000 fakes means faking 1,000,000 tasks at $3 each, $3,000,000 plus 270 days. Like bees guarding nectar, the hive spots the thief at its nadir - one false comb, and the colony expels it.
